## History

Before arriving on the [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island), James lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), after promising his dying sister that he would marry [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott. He was later given a parrot named [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md) by his dying brother, but after a dispute over the bird, [Emily](../character/emily.md) gave him an ultimatum and returned to her own home, leaving them separated. When [Emily](../character/emily.md) unexpectedly arrives seeking him out, the village learns of their long-standing estrangement, though James is secretly pleased by his wife's return.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P29](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0029), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P46](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0046), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058)_
